title: BMW Spider-Man in-car advertising - Consumer Rights Wiki

content_html:
From Consumer Rights Wiki

On July 27, 2026, BMW began delivering a full-screen Spider-Man: Brand New Day movie advertisement to the dashboard Control Display (the car's main center screen) of customer BMW vehicles, placing a branded third-party advertisement in cars their owners had already bought.[1][2] The advertisement appears as a banner at car startup that the driver clicks to play a full-screen animation with backing music and an ambient-lighting light show, and it has been available in more than 70 markets since July 27, 2026, scheduled to run through August 10, 2026, on suitably equipped vehicles running BMW Operating System 7, 8, 8.5, 9, or OS X built after July 2020.[1][3] As recently as December 2023, BMW's connected-company senior vice president Stephan Durach had stated on record that the company would not sell in-car screen space to play a commercial, calling the car a private space.[4] BMW described the animation to The Autopian as part of a broader brand partnership with the film, the automotive slice of a Sony Pictures promotional campaign that Deadline valued at a record $309 million in worldwide media value.[2][5]

  • BMW put an advertisement in a car the owner already paid for: a full-screen Spider-Man: Brand New Day movie ad delivered to the dashboard Control Display of customer vehicles.[1][2]
  • The ad has been available in more than 70 markets since July 27, 2026, scheduled to run through August 10, 2026, on any suitably equipped BMW running Operating System 7, 8, 8.5, 9, or OS X built after July 2020.[1][3]
  • It appears as a banner at startup that the driver clicks to play, with backing music and an ambient-lighting light show.[1][2]
  • The animation was the automotive part of a Sony Pictures promotional campaign that Deadline valued at a record $309 million in worldwide media value.[5]
BMW's stated position on in-car advertising, then its action
Date What BMW said or did
December 2023 Connected-company senior vice president Stephan Durach said BMW would not sell the in-car screen to play a commercial.[4]
July 2026 BMW delivered a full-screen Spider-Man: Brand New Day advertisement to the Control Display of suitably equipped vehicles.[1][2]

BMW has a documented pattern of monetizing hardware and features after the sale of the vehicle. In 2020 the company announced a subscription that charged drivers a recurring fee to activate the heated seats already fitted to their cars.[6] Forbes described that heated-seat subscription as controversial, and BMW dropped it in 2023 in a reversal of the practice. Forbes reported the reversal, quoting BMW board member Pieter Nota on the practices the company would abandon.[6] The heated-seat episode sits in the same family as Features on demand, the broader practice of gating capability a buyer's car already contains behind a paywall.

Two months after dropping the heated-seat subscription, BMW addressed a separate question: whether it would put advertising on the screens inside its cars. At a December 2023 roundtable, Stephan Durach, senior vice president for connected company development at BMW Group, ruled it out. BMWBLOG reported his position, quoting the executive:

To say I'm selling the screen to play a commercial. I don't see it. It's a private space.[4]

BMW's own PressClub release described the advertisement as a special surprise for drivers, timed to the Spider-Man: Brand New Day film, which premiered on July 27, 2026 and was released exclusively in cinemas on July 31, 2026.[1] Starting the car brings up a banner in the Control Display; clicking it activates a full-screen animation with backing music and a light show delivered through the vehicle's ambient lighting system.[1] The Autopian's Jason Torchinsky reported that the banner appears at startup with an option to play the advertisement or not, rather than autoplaying.[2]

The animation has been available in more than 70 markets since July 27, 2026, a limited window scheduled to close on August 10, 2026.[1] Eligibility was broad. Any suitably equipped BMW running BMW Operating System 7, 8, 8.5, 9, or OS X, with a production date after July 2020, could receive it.[1] BMWBLOG's Horatiu Boeriu independently confirmed the same window, the 70-market reach, and the operating-system and build-date requirement.[3]

BMW framed the advertisement as a benefit rather than an intrusion, presenting it as tied to the film partnership rather than as commercial content pushed into the vehicle. Asked about the deployment, BMW told The Autopian in an emailed statement:

The in-vehicle animation is part of a broader brand partnership with the film. A few of our vehicles, including the BMW iX3, were in the film, and a special edition iX3 was featured on the red carpet during last night's premiere in Los Angeles.[2]

Torchinsky, writing for The Autopian, objected to the deployment on ownership grounds, framing the advertisement as something imposed on property the driver had paid for. He drew a comparison to a homeowner making mortgage payments:

I own a house, and I make payments to a mortgage company every month, and I'm pretty sure it would be illegal for that mortgage company to put a fucking Spider-Man billboard in my yard, facing my front windows. Is what BMW is doing any different?[2]

The Autopian also noted that BMW had already been forced to walk back an earlier post-sale monetization push, the heated-seat subscription, after buyers reacted against it.[2]

Torchinsky placed BMW's move alongside earlier in-car advertising from Stellantis, which he wrote had done the same before BMW.[2] The Spider-Man animation was the automotive component of a Sony Pictures promotional campaign that Deadline reported at a worldwide media value of $309 million, described as an all-time record for any Hollywood film and ahead of Sony's previous $288 million record set by Spider-Man: Far From Home.[5] Deadline named BMW as a global partner that wove its Neue Klasse iX3 and 5 Series Sedan into the film.[5]

sentences.zh: 2026 年 7 月 27 日，宝马开始向客户 BMW 车辆的仪表板控制显示屏（汽车的主中控屏幕）投放全屏《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》电影广告，在车主已购买的汽车中放置品牌第三方广告。[1][2]该广告在汽车启动时以横幅形式出现，驾驶员点击即可播放带有背景音乐和环境照明灯光秀的全屏动画，自 2026 年 7 月 27 日起，该广告已在 70 多个市场推出，计划持续到 2026 年 8 月 10 日，适用于运行 BMW 操作系统 7、8、8.5、9 或 2020 年 7 月后生产的 OS X 的适当装备的车辆。[1][3]就在 2023 年 12 月，宝马互联公司高级副总裁 Stephan Durach 曾公开表示，该公司不会出售车内屏幕空间来播放广告，称汽车为私人空间。 [4]宝马向 The Autopian 描述这部动画是与该电影更广泛的品牌合作关系的一部分，该电影是索尼影业宣传活动的汽车部分，截止日期的全球媒体价值达到创纪录的 3.09 亿美元。[2][5]

content_html_zh:
来自消费者权益维基

2026 年 7 月 27 日，宝马开始向客户 BMW 车辆的仪表板控制显示屏（汽车的主中控屏幕）投放全屏《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》电影广告，在车主已购买的汽车中放置品牌第三方广告。[1][2]该广告在汽车启动时以横幅形式出现，驾驶员点击即可播放带有背景音乐和环境照明灯光秀的全屏动画，自 2026 年 7 月 27 日起，该广告已在 70 多个市场推出，计划持续到 2026 年 8 月 10 日，适用于运行 BMW 操作系统 7、8、8.5、9 或 2020 年 7 月后生产的 OS X 的适当装备的车辆。[1][3]就在 2023 年 12 月，宝马互联公司高级副总裁 Stephan Durach 曾公开表示，该公司不会出售车内屏幕空间来播放广告，称汽车为私人空间。 [4]宝马向 The Autopian 描述这部动画是与该电影更广泛的品牌合作关系的一部分，该电影是索尼影业宣传活动的汽车部分，截止日期的全球媒体价值达到创纪录的 3.09 亿美元。[2][5]

  • 宝马在车主已付款的汽车中投放了广告：全屏《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》电影广告投放到客户车辆的仪表板控制显示屏上。[1][2]
  • 该广告自 2026 年 7 月 27 日起已在 70 多个市场投放，计划在 2026 年 8 月 10 日之前在任何配备适当且运行操作系统 7、8、8.5、9 或 2020 年 7 月后构建的 OS X 的 BMW 上投放。[1][3]
  • 它在启动时显示为横幅，驾驶员单击即可播放，并带有背景音乐和环境照明灯光秀。[1][2]
  • 该动画是索尼影业促销活动的汽车部分，Deadline 的全球媒体价值达到创纪录的 3.09 亿美元。 [5]
BMW's stated position on in-car advertising, then its action
Date 宝马所说或所做的
2023 年 12 月 互联公司高级副总裁 Stephan Durach 表示，宝马不会出售车载屏幕来播放广告。[4]
July 2026 宝马在适当装备的车辆的控制显示屏上投放了全屏《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》广告。[1][2]

宝马有一种在售出车辆后通过硬件和功能获利的模式。 2020 年，该公司宣布推出一项订阅服务，向司机收取经常性费用，以激活汽车上已安装的加热座椅。 [6] 《福布斯》称加热座椅订阅颇具争议，宝马也于 2023 年放弃了这一做法，扭转了这一做法。 福布斯报道了这一逆转，并引用了宝马董事会成员彼得·诺塔 (Pieter Nota) 的话说公司将放弃的做法。 [6]加热座椅剧集与“特色点播”属于同一家族，后者是一种更广泛的做法，用于限制买家的汽车已经包含在付费专区后面的功能。

在放弃加热座椅订阅两个月后，宝马解决了一个单独的问题：是否会在车内的屏幕上投放广告。 在 2023 年 12 月的圆桌会议上，宝马集团负责互联公司发展的高级副总裁 Stephan Durach 排除了这种可能性。 BMWBLOG 报道了他的立场，并引用了这位高管的话：

话说我卖屏幕是为了打广告。 我没看到。 这是一个私人空间。[4]

宝马自己的 PressClub 新闻稿将该广告描述为给驾驶员带来的特别惊喜，与《蜘蛛侠：全新一天》电影同步，该电影于 2026 年 7 月 27 日首映，并于 2026 年 7 月 31 日在电影院独家上映。[1]启动汽车后，控制显示屏上会出现一条横幅；单击它会激活全屏动画，并通过车辆的环境照明系统提供背景音乐和灯光秀。[1] Autopian 的 Jason Torchinsky 报告称，横幅在启动时出现，并提供是否播放广告的选项，而不是自动播放。[2]

该动画自 2026 年 7 月 27 日起已在 70 多个市场推出，有限时段预计于 2026 年 8 月 10 日关闭。[1]资格很广泛。 任何配备适当且运行 BMW 操作系统 7、8、8.5、9 或 OS X 且生产日期在 2020 年 7 月之后的 BMW 都可以收到该许可证。 [1] BMWBLOG 的 Horatiu Boeriu 独立确认了同一窗口、70 个市场覆盖范围以及操作系统和构建日期要求。[3]

宝马将广告定位为一种利益而不是一种入侵，将其呈现为与电影合作伙伴关系相关的而非将商业内容推送到车辆中的形式。 当被问及此次部署时，宝马在一份电子邮件声明中告诉 Autopian：

车载动画是与电影更广泛的品牌合作伙伴关系的一部分。 我们的一些车辆（包括 BMW iX3）出现在电影中，特别版 iX3 在昨晚洛杉矶首映式的红地毯上亮相。[2]

Torchinsky 为《The Autopian》撰稿，以所有权为由反对这种部署，并将广告描述为强加给司机所支付的财产的东西。 他与房主支付抵押贷款进行了比较：

我拥有一栋房子，每个月都会向抵押贷款公司付款，而且我很确定抵押贷款公司在我的院子里面向我的前窗放置一个该死的蜘蛛侠广告牌是违法的。 宝马正在做的事情有什么不同吗？[2]

Autopian 还指出，在买家做出反应后，宝马已经被迫取消了早期的售后货币化举措，即加热座椅订阅。 [2]

Torchinsky 将宝马的举措与 Stellantis 早期的车载广告放在一起，他写道，Stellantis 在宝马之前也做过同样的事情。 [2] 《蜘蛛侠》动画是索尼影业宣传活动中的汽车部分，据《Deadline》报道，该活动的全球媒体价值为 3.09 亿美元，被称为好莱坞电影的历史纪录，并且超过了索尼之前由《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》创下的 2.88 亿美元纪录。 [5] Deadline 指定宝马为全球合作伙伴，并将其 Neue Klasse iX3 和 5 系轿车融入到影片中。[5]
